+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+class DeadLetterPublisher:
+    def __init__(self, queue_url: Optional[str] = None, region: Optional[str] = None):
+        self.queue_url = queue_url or os.environ.get("AWS_SQS_DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE_URL")
+        self.region = region or os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1")
+        if not self.queue_url:
+            raise ValueError("AWS_SQS_DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE_URL is required")
+
+    def send_failed_message(self, message: Any, reason: str, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        payload = {
+            "failed_message": message,
+            "reason": reason,
+            "metadata": metadata or {},
+        }
+        body = json.dumps(payload, default=str)
+        response = requests.post(
+            self.queue_url,
+            headers={
+                "Content-Type": "application/json",
+                "X-AWS-Region": self.region,
+            },
+            data=body,
+            timeout=30,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return {"status_code": response.status_code, "response_text": response.text}
+
+
+def send_to_dead_letter(message: Any, reason: str, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return DeadLetterPublisher().send_failed_message(message, reason, metadata)
*** End Patch

+import os
+from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
+
+
+def main():
+    project_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    subscription_id = os.environ["PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION_ID"]
+    subscription_path = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient().subscription_path(project_id, subscription_id)
+    client = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient()
+    response = client.pull(request={"subscription": subscription_path, "max_messages": 1}, timeout=30)
+    if not response.received_messages:
+        return
+    received = response.received_messages[0]
+    print(received.message.data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
+    client.acknowledge(request={"subscription": subscription_path, "ack_ids": [received.ack_id]})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: publish_event.py
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+
+from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
+
+
+def publish_event(event: dict) -> str:
+    project_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    topic_id = os.environ["PUBSUB_TOPIC"]
+    publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
+    topic_path = publisher.topic_path(project_id, topic_id)
+    data = json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    future = publisher.publish(topic_path, data=data, content_type="application/json")
+    return future.result()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: publish_event.py '<json>'")
+    event = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
+    message_id = publish_event(event)
+    sys.stdout.write(message_id)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
